verdict.rationale: Terraform's core interface remains HCL config files and explicit CLI commands (plan/apply/import), not natural language. The official MCP server gives AI models real-time access to provider docs, modules, and policies to help generate more accurate configurations, which is a step toward AI-native operation, but there is no evidence of a natural-language command interface for running Terraform actions directly. Missing for 10: a documented NL-to-command translation layer, evidence of AI agents actually driving terraform plan/apply via natural language, and independent corroboration of the MCP server enabling full operational control rather than just documentation lookup.
